inventar.name: Inventory
inventar.description: Keep track of boxes, what is inside them and what you have lent to others.
inventar.example: Example: label box 12 in the basement with a QR code and later search for where the cordless drill is.

datentraeger.name: Drives
datentraeger.description: Label drives of this PC and disks in servers that Tapesmith reads over SSH, and walk through a disk replacement in ZFS pools.
datentraeger.example: Example: print all disks of a server with slot and serial number as a series.
datentraeger.requires: For the SSH scanner and disk replacement: SSH access with a key to the Linux hosts.

proxmox.name: Proxmox
proxmox.description: Reads VMs and containers from Proxmox VE and prints labels for them.
proxmox.example: Example: one label per VM with name, ID and IP address.
proxmox.requires: Proxmox VE with an API token (read access only).

paperless.name: Paperless
paperless.description: Assigns ASN numbers for Paperless-ngx and prints warranty labels from your invoices.
paperless.example: Example: reserve 20 ASN labels and stick them on receipts before scanning.
paperless.requires: Paperless-ngx with an API token (for warranty labels).

homeassistant.name: Home Assistant
homeassistant.description: Shows devices with a weak battery from Home Assistant and prints battery and maintenance labels.
homeassistant.example: Example: one label per smoke detector with battery type and replacement date.
homeassistant.requires: Home Assistant with a long-lived access token.

vault.name: Obsidian vault
vault.description: Prints labels from notes in your Obsidian vault and records the print in the note.
vault.example: Example: print a label with hostname and IP address from a server's note.
vault.requires: Obsidian MCP server or a reachable vault folder.

assets.name: Assets
assets.description: Numbers devices consecutively and prints asset labels with a QR code, optionally with a short link.
assets.example: Example: stick HL-0042 on the NAS, the QR code leads straight to the device note.
assets.requires: Optional: a short link service for short QR codes.

kabel.name: Cables
kabel.description: Assigns cable IDs following TIA-606 and prints cable flags from a NetBox export.
kabel.example: Example: label all patch cables of a rack from the NetBox CSV as a series.

kleinanzeigen.name: Classifieds
kleinanzeigen.description: Manages things you want to sell and labels them with number, price and a QR code to the listing.
kleinanzeigen.example: Example: stick KA-007 with the price on the box so buyers find the listing.

snscan.name: Serial number scan
snscan.description: Reads serial numbers from a photo of the manufacturer sticker (barcode, DataMatrix or QR code).
snscan.example: Example: take a photo of an SSD sticker and copy the serial number straight into the label.

disabled: Module {name} is turned off, turn it on under Settings > Modules or `tapesmith module enable {id}`
